metadata.case_name: LAM CHAN HUNG v. HANG YUE ENGINEERING LIMITED AND OTHERS

injuries.description: Burst fracture of L3 vertebra with 30% compromise and retropulsed bone fragments
source: Subsequent CT and MRI scans showed burst fracture of L3 vertebra with 30% compromise and retropulsed bone fragments, and he underwent an operation for closed reduction and percutaneous pedicle screws fixation from L2 to L4 on 3 April 2008.
he was treated with open reduction and internal fixation for the right foot and ankle fractures
They also agreed that the plaintiff suffered from right ankle and foot fracture as a result of the accident and that there was no evidence of any pre-existing problems at the injured parts.
injuries.icd_description: Multiple injuries of ankle or foot

injuries.description: Fractures of the ribs (right 9th and 10th ribs)
source: He had fractures of the ribs in both sides and the lower back.
The plaintiff had recovered satisfactorily from the fractures of the right 9th and 10th ribs

manifestations.description: Sharp right ankle pain; pain may come suddenly, may worsen with walking and in cold weather
Limping gait and impaired ambulation; relies on a stick when going out; tolerates walking 15-20 minutes with a stick
Limited ankle motion, weaker ankle power, thinner right thigh and calf muscles, multiple surgical scars and tenderness at right ankle and foot
Loss of lumbar lordosis, surgical scars and tenderness at lumbar spine, tenderness at midline and both sides of lumbar region and poor back movement
Urinary frequency and nocturia (started after removal of Foley catheter); urinary symptoms largely caused by BPH and possibly aggravated by back and right lower limb problems
Impotence / sexual dysfunction; not able to maintain a normal erection and has not had sexual intercourse with his wife since the accident
Adjustment disorder with features of post-traumatic stress disorder including irritable mood, recurring nightmares, flashbacks, sleep disturbance and avoidance
Reduced physical capacity for work: cannot squat, jump or run; unable to return to pre-injury work in construction sites

treatments_received: Open reduction and internal fixation for right foot and ankle fractures
Closed reduction and percutaneous pedicle screws fixation from L2 to L4 (3 April 2008)
Removal of right foot implant (22 May 2008)
Removal of right ankle implant (14 September 2009)
Physiotherapy and rehabilitation including hydrotherapy; occupational therapy and reconditioning training

losses.description: Serious and continuing permanent disabilities arising from his back and leg problems which adversely affect the quality and enjoyment of his life.
Impaired ambulation: limping gait, reliance on a walking stick, reduced walking tolerance and inability to squat, jump or run.

losses.category: Loss of sexual function and sexual life
losses.description: Impotence and inability to maintain a normal erection; no sexual intercourse with his wife since the accident.

losses.category: Loss of ability to engage in sports and hobbies
losses.description: Unable to squat, jump or run; reduced physical ability to participate in previously possible activities.

losses.category: Loss of confidence in going out in the public
losses.description: Seldom goes out and when he does is accompanied by his wife; avoidance and fear related to the accident.
